options_evaluated: Impact-resistant virgin polymer with high-durability ribbing
Composite material with co-molded rubber bumpers
assessments.recommendation: Impact-resistant virgin polymer with high-durability ribbing
assessments.rationale: To prevent premature obsolescence (Page 27, definition 21) and ensure durability and reliability under specified conditions of use (Page 27, definition 22), the housing must withstand stress and aging mechanisms (Page 79, parameter a). A robust virgin polymer housing also avoids microplastic and nanoplastic release during the use stage (Page 80, parameter p) which would occur from degradation of lower-quality recycled or composite materials, and ensures functional performance (Page 80, parameter s).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, because virgin polymer has a higher initial material footprint (Page 28, definition 26) and carbon footprint during production compared to lightweight recycled plastics.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts
assessments.recommendation: Threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts
assessments.rationale: This option maximizes ease of repair and maintenance (Page 79, parameter b) by ensuring compatibility with commonly available tools (Page 79, parameter b; Page 8) and enabling non-destructive disassembly. This prevents premature obsolescence (Page 27, definition 21) and supports the replacement of defective parts to return the product to its intended purpose (Page 27, definition 20).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, because threaded fasteners with brass inserts increase assembly complexity, part count, and manufacturing costs.

options_evaluated: High-efficiency brushless DC motor with digital control
Compact integrated permanent magnet motor with sealed housing
assessments.recommendation: High-efficiency brushless DC motor with digital control
assessments.rationale: This option significantly steps up energy efficiency and decreases the product's energy footprint during the in-service phase (Page 3), directly serving parameter (g) (energy consumption while in service, Page 79). It also improves durability and reliability (Page 79, parameter a) through a longer technical lifetime and mean time between failures (Page 79, parameter a) compared to brushed motors which wear out quickly, causing premature obsolescence (Page 27, definition 21).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, due to the higher cost, use of critical raw materials (Page 79, parameter h), and complex electronic controls.

options_evaluated: Active fan cooling with replaceable dust filters
Passive convective heat sinking with sealed enclosure
assessments.recommendation: Active fan cooling with replaceable dust filters
assessments.rationale: Active cooling maintains optimal operating temperatures, ensuring functional performance and reliability under conditions of use (Page 80, parameter s; Page 27, definition 23). The dust filters prevent dust ingress into the motor, preventing premature obsolescence (Page 27, definition 21). Dust filters are consumables whose quantity, characteristics, and availability must be ensured for proper maintenance (Page 79, parameter l).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage (adds components and complexity) and End-of-Life stage (generates consumable filter waste, Page 80, parameter r).

options_evaluated: Fully modular architecture with easily swappable sub-assemblies
Semi-modular design with integrated core and detachable accessories
assessments.recommendation: Fully modular architecture with easily swappable sub-assemblies
assessments.rationale: A fully modular architecture maximizes ease of repair and maintenance (Page 79, parameter b) by allowing professional repairers (Page 29, definition 48) or consumers to easily swap out defective modules using commonly available tools (Page 79, parameter b; Page 8). This directly prevents premature obsolescence (Page 27, definition 21) and minimizes the amount of waste generated by using the product (Page 80, parameter r) since only the failed module is discarded rather than the entire vacuum cleaner.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, because modularity increases the weight, volume, and material footprint (Page 28, definition 26) of the product due to additional connectors and housing structures.

options_evaluated: Mains-powered corded with automatic cord reel
Removable and standardized lithium-ion battery pack
assessments.recommendation: Removable and standardized lithium-ion battery pack
assessments.rationale: A removable and standardized battery pack provides functional performance and flexibility (Page 80, parameter s) while addressing the primary failure point of cordless vacuum cleaners. By making the battery pack easily removable and standardized, we ensure the availability and accessibility of spare parts (Page 79, parameter l) and ease of repair/maintenance (Page 79, parameter b), preventing premature obsolescence (Page 27, definition 21) when the battery degrades. This maintains the product's technical lifetime (Page 79, parameter a) and reduces the environmental footprint and waste generated (Page 80, parameter r; Page 79, parameter m).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing stage, because battery packs require complex battery management systems, and End-of-Life stage due to the hazardous waste generated by batteries (Page 80, parameter r).
